reasons.v3/admission_a13.py: New A13 module, Part 2.12: sealed admission binding of residual row identifiers, hashes and cell classes; the floor(N/1000), one-per-context, balanced-exclusion, screen, support and sensitivity limits; prospective decision-incidence counting and per-run and per-branch aggregation. Used only when a family manifest carries an A13 admission binding; no completed A10 estimation or validation computation imports it.
reasons.v3/artifacts.py: A13 order step 2: verify_registration gains a historical mode (ancestry and committed bytes only, no working-note comparison) for plans registered before 48815a65, and current A10 launches require the exact A13 clarification pin 48815a65 with its working-note bytes; adds A13_COMMIT. Digest, seal, canonical JSON, seed and job-identity functions are unchanged. A2 re-pinned.
reasons.v3/compatibility_a10.py: A13 order step 2: build_record verifies each registered source plan's historical registration pin before reading any proof output. Proof-tool revision (fcfcb898, executor tooling under A11 item 3): source collection is factored into collect_record and proof_row for single-host and sharded proofs; the legacy single-host build adds memory admission (registered class and phase estimates, an optional observed floor), one spawned process per job, memory-safe configuration preflight, input views, and the fixed identity-pair attempt reservation. Population, stratum, selection, canonical comparison bytes, before/after hashes, record fields and approval are unchanged. Worker-control revision (c2b1786e, executor scheduling only): the legacy single-host builder uses per-class reservations instead of a global floor (--memory-floor-gb is deprecated with no effect), accepts the reasoned override flags and a control command. Item 10 revision (75e89e44, executor scheduling only): the legacy single-host builder takes --profile, --mode and --cpu-budget, derives its cap from the production caps, and passes class peaks and configuration measurements to the shared item 10 scheduler. Population, stratum, selection, comparison bytes, record fields and approval are unchanged.
reasons.v3/compatibility_shards_a11.py: New executor-only proof tool (fcfcb898, A11 item 3 with the A12 execution-only clarification): the memory-aware two-host A11 proof. Qualification bundle of short non-registered profiles (at least 20 per kind), host validation against X2-1, deterministic LPT shard assignment by registered cost and measured rate, one exclusive frozen attempt with an identity-pair reservation, per-host staged hash-verified inputs, memory-admitted execution after configuration tests with a one-use start marker, combine into the unchanged compatibility_a10 record, and an output-blind projection. It changes no job, seed, setting, selection, comparison or scientific computation. Worker-control revision (c2b1786e, executor scheduling only): shards reserve per-class memory from original completion RSS (no global floor), accept the reasoned override flags, a live control command and a load-sheet command, and write informational status. Selection, comparison, reservation, finality and approval unchanged. Item 10 revision (75e89e44, executor scheduling only): shards charge item 10 admission over their frozen assignment, run each proof job in an isolated single-job spawn pool with durable return journals and the bounded signal rerun (a returned mismatch or a fourth kill stays final), test configuration through the usable cap with trial memory classes, record and check free swap in preflight, add a read-only --historical load sheet for a sealed old attempt, and make status writes best-effort. Selection, comparison, reservation, finality and approval unchanged.
reasons.v3/dispatch_store_a11.py: Item 10 revision (75e89e44, executor scheduling only): the pull store lists the eligible unleased reservations needed for the top-quarter admission weight W, and a queue head is admissible when min(its reservation, W) fits the host's free budget. Claim order (longest frozen bundle first, then job id), job identity, seeds, leases, completions and checks are unchanged.
reasons.v3/host_a11.py: A12 part 2, E2 and E3 port: current memory reporting on heartbeat and ready; an explicit per-host model service (llm or none) independent of hostname, with the X2 profile requiring Linux. A13 Part 1.7: execute_scratch passes coordinator checkpoints and the recheck flag to the extension, and the host transfers replicate checkpoints and scientific-halt markers to the coordinator. Worker-control revision (c2b1786e, executor scheduling only): hosts accept the reasoned override flags, report per-job peak RSS, follow live targets, and surface a worker failure traceback. Item 10 revision (75e89e44, executor scheduling only): each job's spawned child sets oom_score_adj 1000 and records it with the output; the host records its swap preflight before joining; a child killed by a signal without an output is released for a fresh claim (both memory guards apply again) instead of failing the host; per-profile slot requests.
reasons.v3/integration.py: A13 Part 2.11: observation hooks around actual allocation and yield decisions record decision incidence only when the loaded family carries an A13 admission binding. Existing selection behavior and result fields are unchanged; the rehearsal's run-side equivalence reproduced c19b54f5 result bytes. A2 re-pinned.
reasons.v3/multihost_a11.py: A12 part 2: E2's bounded five-second preference for the fastest eligible non-original recheck host, then fallback; E3's register entries record the approved profile and model service, and join checks them instead of the X2 hostname. A13: a13_validate_plain_ext admitted as a pull kind, round binding at prepare, the scientific-halt latch, the checkpoint and halt operations and an R_max ordering weight; 25b5f052 adds a13_checkpoint and a13_halt to the RPC allowlist. Worker-control revision (c2b1786e, executor scheduling only): per-host and overall live worker targets, mode-capped selection, memory-authority checks before any control state or event is written, RSS class validation and per-class admission in claims and checks. Item 10 revision (75e89e44, executor scheduling only): claims and checks charge min(reservation, W) over the host's eligible unleased jobs plus its own active leases; per-profile slot gates under the host target; a 'worker signal kill' release records a durable signal_restart event and re-queues the same job, halting after a fourth kill; the join records the host's swap preflight; informational writes best-effort. Comparison and nondeterminism handling are unchanged.
reasons.v3/production_runner.py: A12 part 2, E1 and E3: local candidate handling and the hostname-free X2 profile check through the per-host model service. A13: dispatch of a13_validate_plain_ext with reserved-seed guards for non-registered runs, round binding and halt latch, the decision-incidence run summary only when the family has admitted rows, memory management for the extension schema, and a guard rejecting the A13 reserved seed range for every other job kind. A2 re-pinned. Worker-control revision (c2b1786e, executor scheduling only): per-class memory admission, reasoned --override-reason/--operator/--memory-headroom launch overrides, live control and load-sheet commands, peak-RSS executor metadata in completion records; A2 re-pinned again (0f1be673 to 02e8f77b, recorded under a10.worker_control_revision). Scientific execute and completion paths unchanged. Item 10 revision (75e89e44, executor scheduling only): X2 normal and work caps both n minus one (31 at 32 CPUs); configuration trials test through the usable cap with trial memory classes; single-host dispatch uses item 10 admission across unfinished phases; simulation children set oom_score_adj 1000; signal-killed workers without a result rerun from their original seed at most three times with a durable restart journal; X2 swap preflight; informational writes best-effort. A2 re-pinned (02e8f77b to e9fe15b9, recorded under a10.item10_admission_revision). Scientific execute and completed functions, outputs, completion and checkpoint writes are unchanged and strict.
reasons.v3/production_tables.py: A13 Part 2.12: the loader verifies an A13 admission binding when present and keeps admitted residual rows bound and unavailable; without a binding, rows load exactly as before (zero-admission loader equivalence passed in the rehearsal). A2 re-pinned.
reasons.v3/qualification_a11.py: A12 part 2, E3: qualification records the candidate's model service. A13: qualification of a13_validate_plain_ext uses non-registered fixture streams (seeds at or above 2**128) rather than registered outputs. The original X2 reference rule is unchanged. Worker-control revision (c2b1786e, executor scheduling only): qualification runs take the reasoned override flags with per-class memory admission, record per-job worker seconds, and scheduling uses the per-job rate rather than elapsed concurrency. Item 10 revision (75e89e44, executor scheduling only): qualification runs use item 10 admission, X2 normal mode, an isolated single-job spawn pool per admission with return journals, the bounded signal rerun and the swap preflight. The reference rule, comparison and evidence fields used for approval are unchanged.
reasons.v3/service.py: A12 part 2, E3: per-host model service, llm or none, with an explicit no-service record; X2 supervision requires the X2 profile on Linux rather than the hostname. LF-only, port hash 623db8ef. A2 re-pinned. Item 10 revision (75e89e44, executor scheduling only): service metadata and command logs are written best-effort, so an informational write failure cannot fail execution or prevent restoration; commands still run once and their exit status is checked. A2 re-pinned (623db8ef to 3e90a951).
reasons.v3/snapshot_a11.py: A13: adds a13_validate_plain_ext to the job kinds whose A1 source and fit inputs are snapshotted for pull workers. reasons.v3/validation_extension_a13.py: New A13 module, Part 1.1 to 1.10 and orders 5 and 7: the one-round targeted plain-validation extension (eligibility, N*, separated seed namespace, pricing and R_max, ordered replicate execution with durable checkpoints, the first-N* test, reassembly of eligible C0 decisions with ineligible byte identity, the round record and halt latch, and publication with the amended receipt). It is not part of any completed estimation or validation computation.
reasons.v3/worker_control.py: New executor-only module (c2b1786e): worker selection, reasoned initial overrides, persistent live host and overall targets, mode handling (MODE_CAPS_TARGET = True: min(target, mode cap)), per-class memory reservations (each job reserves max(its registered class estimate, its own class's measured peak x 1.2)), memory-authority checks for above-mode targets, and output-blind load sheets. No job, seed, setting, result, selection or comparison is read or changed. Item 10 revision (75e89e44, executor scheduling only): item 10 admission charges each job min(its class reservation, W), W being the mean reservation of the heaviest ceil(n/4) unfinished jobs, recomputed after completions; short configuration trials have their own 0.25 GB bootstrap and measured trial classes; a profile's measured choice bounds only its own active jobs under the host target; load sheets report the per-class and item 10 rules side by side, including initial, mean and maximum workers and the final drain; registered launches refuse classes without a sealed estimate or measured peak. No job, seed, setting, result, selection or comparison is read or changed.
reasons.v3/worker_safety.py: New executor-only module (75e89e44, item 10): X2 swap preflight (records total and free swap, refuses below 16 GB free), oom_score_adj 1000 set only inside spawned simulation children, bounded rerun of a signal-killed worker that returned no result (same job, seed and configuration, at most three times, durable restart events), isolated single-job spawn pools with durable return journals for proof and qualification, and best-effort informational metadata writes. It reads and changes no job, seed, setting, result, selection or comparison.
